satirlar.m: Morning. The office. Peri sits at her desk in a beige trench coat, a scarf over her hair, big sunglasses pushed up on her forehead. Cengo stops in the doorway and stares.
What's with the getup? Did you come straight from a film set?
It's a disguise. A detective on a trail mustn't be recognized. It says so in the book.
There's no case. Whose trail are you even on?
Today's client. A detective comes prepared.
A knock at the door. On the threshold stands a tall, upright lady with snow-white hair. She carries a cane, but never lets it touch the floor.
Miss Peri! I've been a fan of yours for years.
The disguise works wonders. She knew you the second she walked in.
